brief_rationale: The doctor successfully completed all six responsibility-chain items with no serious or minor errors. All five dimensions are at least good. The doctor completed all four high-order test points: navigating cost/transport barriers (HO1), repairing patient hesitation about waiting until weekend (HO2), adapting communication to patient anxiety about cancer (HO3), and achieving safe bounded closure (HO4). Two or more high-order points with meaningful trajectory impact and valid closure yields grade 5.
